newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian economy seen reviving - PM's office.
newsitem.headline: Italian economy seen reviving - PM's office.

text.p: The Italian economy has touched bottom and is already on the road to recovery, cabinet secretary Enrico Micheli said on Thursday.

Micheli told Reuters that March retail sales figures released earlier on Thursday -- showing a 1.8 percent year-on-year increase -- "confirm that the 0.2 percent fall in GDP in the first quarter was the concluding phase of a trend."
The data released by national statistics institute Istat measure retail sales of large and medium sized firms in Italy.

"Since April the trend is one of improvement, especially for basic consumption and capital goods which ... lead a recovery. We hit rock bottom some time ago and we are now in a growth phase," he said.
